title.en: A remembered time association leaves explanations open
title.zh: 记得的时间关联保留解释未知

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的安四条依次选部分符合、很符合、未计分、与回忆不符；澈对调前两条，六类数量相同，却对应心情与活动精力的不同描述。安记得那段时间安排也有变化，这只是另一项背景，不证明日照、天气或作息造成感受。四条不提供同一时间发生、持续多久或两次年度发作的证据，不把很符合翻译为发生很多天。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional An selects partly matches, closely matches, unscored and does not match; Che swaps the first two. Equal counts concern different descriptions of mood and activity energy. An also recalls changed obligations, which are additional context rather than proof of a daylight, weather or routine cause. The four labels establish no simultaneous change, duration or two annual episodes, and closely matching does not mean many days.

title.en: Keep an optional question without a season-changing task
title.zh: 留下自愿问题，不安排改变季节环境的任务

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样把一年中的时间、记得的区别和未知原因分别说清？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替真人推断诊断，不要求个人年份记录，也不把讨论变成验证季节模式的任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can time of year, a remembered contrast and an unknown cause be stated separately?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without diagnosing a real person, personal yearly records or a task to verify seasonal patterns.

paragraphs.zh: 16条为费马原创成人回顾，不是SPAQ、季节性抑郁评估或临床筛查。过去两年只是编辑回忆窗口，不核实两次年度发作、持续规则或临床缓解，也不是等待期。不输入日期、月份、地点、半球或个人史，不预设冬季、夏季、日照较短、天气或生理原因。六类是与回忆不符、稍微符合、部分符合、大体符合、很符合、未计分；0至4仅为类别ID，不是点数、频率、天数、症状强度或季节变化量。四主题各四条，各自六类计数合计4，保留16条逐项所选标签。未计分可指无经历、回想或时间不清、不愿回答，网页不区分原因，与不符分别保留，不填零或中间值。每条各选一个给定类别才整理，全未计分也能完成，不建立健康或没有支持需要的结论。没有加总、均值、排名、最高主题、反向计分或季节类型；时间主题不加权，持续和例外不从重复或接近平常中扣除。类别不确认或排除季节性情感障碍、其他状况、原因、临床发作或缓解，也不评估身体变化无害、营养是否足够、医疗需要或紧急程度。尚无常模、诊断阈值、验证或双语测量等值；之后类别不同不证明恢复、恶化、真实季节变化或治疗效果。NIMH资料只作更广评估与支持背景，不验证原创题目或新增虚构情境。四篇七节全文与支持始终公开，未答、未计分、退出都可读；可选讨论只用虚构信息，不要求本人记录、重建日历、查旧消息、天气或光照接触、身体及食物监测、改变睡眠饮食或披露经历。已有照护、意见、监测和支持独立保留，不据类别改药、用补充剂、取消支持、推迟评估或把持续担忧当成只是季节性。答案及记录仅留本页内存，无草稿、提交、问卷分析或个人结果地址；完成清除作答状态，退出、重做、刷新、离页清除记录，不恢复。复制只含公开标题及入口，不含模式、类别或计数；清除不抹掉截图、浏览器记录或他人已看到的信息。可以不完成、不达到计数、不再等一个季节或年份就询问合格专业人员；有即时危险或无法保障安全时寻求当地紧急援助，不继续以本页判断。
paragraphs.en: These 16 original adult recollections are not SPAQ, a seasonal-depression assessment or a clinical screen. Two years is an editorial recall window, not verification of two annual episodes, duration or remission and not a waiting period. No dates, months, location, hemisphere or personal history are entered; no winter, summer, shorter daylight, weather or biological cause is assumed. Six categories are does not match my recollection, matches slightly, partly, mostly, closely and unscored. IDs zero through four are not points, frequency, days, intensity or seasonal-change magnitude. Four themes contain four descriptions each; six counts sum to four per theme, retaining all 16 selected labels. Unscored can mean no experience, unclear recall or timing, or withholding without identifying the reason. It remains distinct from does not match, without zero or midpoint imputation. Every description needs an offered category to organize a record. All-unscored can finish without certifying health or no need for support. There is no total, mean, ranking, highest topic, reversal or seasonal type. Timing receives no extra weight; persistence and exceptions are not subtracted from recurrence or moving toward usual. Categories confirm or exclude no seasonal affective disorder or other condition, cause, episode or remission. They assess no harmless physical change, nutritional adequacy, healthcare need or urgency. No norms, diagnostic thresholds, validation or bilingual equivalence are established; changed categories prove no recovery, worsening, true seasonal change or treatment effect. NIMH supplies broader assessment and support background, not validation of these items or fictional scenes. All four seven-section guides and support stay public without answers, with unscored records or after leaving. Optional discussion uses fiction without personal records, reconstructed calendars, old messages, weather or light exposure, body or food monitoring, altered sleep or diet, or disclosure. Keep existing care, advice, monitoring and support independent. Categories justify no medicine changes, supplements, cancelled support, delayed assessment or dismissal of persistent concerns as only seasonal. Answers and records stay in page memory without drafts, submission, questionnaire analytics or personal-result addresses. Completing clears answer state; exit, retake, reload and leaving clear the record without restoration. Copying includes only the public title and entry, not patterns, categories or counts. Clearing erases no screenshots, browser records or information already seen. You can ask a qualified professional without completion, a count or another season or year. Immediate danger or inability to stay safe calls for local emergency assistance rather than a decision through this page.

title.en: Opposite descriptions need not become a contradiction
title.zh: 相反方向的描述不必变成矛盾

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的时记得某段时间更想睡，另一段更难安睡，前两条均大体符合；较早醒来那条未计分，起床困难那条与回忆不符。六类中大体符合2、未计分1、不符1，其余为0。两条贴切描述不一定同年、同期或同一原因，不能合成冬季型或夏季型；不需要量睡眠、熬夜或改起床时刻来让对比更清楚。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Shi recalls wanting more sleep during one part of a year and difficulty settling during another. Both mostly match; early waking is unscored and difficulty getting up does not match. Counts are two mostly matches, one unscored and one nonmatch, with zeros elsewhere. The two descriptions need not concern one year, period or cause. They produce no winter or summer type and require no sleep measurement, staying awake or changed waking time.

title.en: Keep an optional question without a sleep instruction
title.zh: 留下自愿问题，不给睡眠指示

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“为什么多睡与难安睡的回忆不必被合成一种季节类型？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替真人推断诊断，不要求个人年份记录，也不把讨论变成验证季节模式的任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Why need recollections of wanting more sleep and difficulty settling not form one seasonal type?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without diagnosing a real person, personal yearly records or a task to verify seasonal patterns.

title.en: A food-related contrast does not explain itself
title.zh: 与食物有关的对比不会自行解释原因

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的予四条依次选部分符合、很符合、未计分、与回忆不符，记得食物兴趣与想吃东西有所不同，却没有记录食量。宁的未计分是保留回答，另一个人的未计分是时间记不清，网页不能区分原因。食物可得性、偏好、进食量与营养状况也不是同一信息，不凭标签建议限制、增加食物、比较身体或改变已有照护。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Yu selects partly matches, closely matches, unscored and does not match, recalling differences in food appeal and wanting food without measured intake. Ning withholds an item while another person cannot recall timing; the page distinguishes neither unscored reason. Availability, preference, intake and nutritional status are different information. No label prescribes restriction, extra food, body comparisons or changes to existing care.

title.en: A concern can be discussed without a calendar or food diary
title.zh: 无需日历或饮食日记即可讨论担忧

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样区分食物兴趣、可得性和未测量的进食情况，而不作身体裁定？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替真人推断诊断，不要求个人年份记录，也不把讨论变成验证季节模式的任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can food interest, availability and unmeasured intake be distinguished without a body-related verdict?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without diagnosing a real person, personal yearly records or a task to verify seasonal patterns.

title.en: Exceptions are observations, not negative points

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的芃四条都选很符合：记得相近时间再次出现、后来接近平时、某项变化继续，以及预期外时间也有相似经历。四条只进入同一类别，不证明整齐一致的季节发作；例外不从重复中扣掉，时间主题不加权。过去两年是编辑回想窗口，不要求完整两年记录或再等一年，接近平时也不由网页称为临床缓解。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Peng selects closely matches for recurrence at a similar time, later movement toward usual, persistence and an unexpected-time experience. Four labels in one category verify no orderly seasonal episode. Exceptions are not subtracted from recurrence, and timing receives no extra weight. Two years is the editorial recall window, not a demand for two years of notes or another year’s wait. Moving toward usual is not classified as clinical remission.

title.en: Ask about the concern without proving a yearly pattern
title.zh: 无需证明年度模式即可咨询担忧

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“为什么重复、继续和例外可以并存，而不相减或放大为诊断？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不替真人推断诊断，不要求个人年份记录，也不把讨论变成验证季节模式的任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Why can recurrence, persistence and exceptions coexist without subtraction or amplification into a diagnosis?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without diagnosing a real person, personal yearly records or a task to verify seasonal patterns.

paragraphs.zh: 16条为费马原创成人回顾，不是SPAQ、季节性抑郁评估或临床筛查。过去两年只是编辑回忆窗口，不核实两次年度发作、持续规则或临床缓解，也不是等待期。不输入日期、月份、地点、半球或个人史，不预设冬季、夏季、日照较短、天气或生理原因。六类是与回忆不符、稍微符合、部分符合、大体符合、很符合、未计分；0至4仅为类别ID，不是点数、频率、天数、症状强度或季节变化量。四主题各四条，各自六类计数合计4，保留16条逐项所选标签。未计分可指无经历、回想或时间不清、不愿回答，网页不区分原因，与不符分别保留，不填零或中间值。每条各选一个给定类别才整理，全未计分也能完成，不建立健康或没有支持需要的结论。没有加总、均值、排名、最高主题、反向计分或季节类型；时间主题不加权，持续和例外不从重复或接近平常中扣除。类别不确认或排除季节性情感障碍、其他状况、原因、临床发作或缓解，也不评估身体变化无害、营养是否足够、医疗需要或紧急程度。尚无常模、诊断阈值、验证或双语测量等值；之后类别不同不证明恢复、恶化、真实季节变化或治疗效果。NIMH资料只作更广评估与支持背景，不验证原创题目或新增虚构情境。四篇七节全文与支持始终公开，未答、未计分、退出都可读；可选讨论只用虚构信息，不要求本人记录、重建日历、查旧消息、天气或光照接触、身体及食物监测、改变睡眠饮食或披露经历。已有照护、意见、监测和支持独立保留，不据类别改药、用补充剂、取消支持、推迟评估或把持续担忧当成只是季节性。答案及记录仅留本页内存，无草稿、提交、问卷分析或个人结果地址；完成清除作答状态，退出、重做、刷新、离页清除记录，不恢复。复制只含公开标题及入口，不含模式、类别或计数；清除不抹掉截图、浏览器记录或他人已看到的信息。可以不完成、不达到计数、不再等一个季节或年份就询问合格专业人员；有即时危险或无法保障安全时寻求当地紧急援助，不继续以本页判断。
paragraphs.en: These 16 original adult recollections are not SPAQ, a seasonal-depression assessment or a clinical screen. Two years is an editorial recall window, not verification of two annual episodes, duration or remission and not a waiting period. No dates, months, location, hemisphere or personal history are entered; no winter, summer, shorter daylight, weather or biological cause is assumed. Six categories are does not match my recollection, matches slightly, partly, mostly, closely and unscored. IDs zero through four are not points, frequency, days, intensity or seasonal-change magnitude. Four themes contain four descriptions each; six counts sum to four per theme, retaining all 16 selected labels. Unscored can mean no experience, unclear recall or timing, or withholding without identifying the reason. It remains distinct from does not match, without zero or midpoint imputation. Every description needs an offered category to organize a record. All-unscored can finish without certifying health or no need for support. There is no total, mean, ranking, highest topic, reversal or seasonal type. Timing receives no extra weight; persistence and exceptions are not subtracted from recurrence or moving toward usual. Categories confirm or exclude no seasonal affective disorder or other condition, cause, episode or remission. They assess no harmless physical change, nutritional adequacy, healthcare need or urgency. No norms, diagnostic thresholds, validation or bilingual equivalence are established; changed categories prove no recovery, worsening, true seasonal change or treatment effect. NIMH supplies broader assessment and support background, not validation of these items or fictional scenes. All four seven-section guides and support stay public without answers, with unscored records or after leaving. Optional discussion uses fiction without personal records, reconstructed calendars, old messages, weather or light exposure, body or food monitoring, altered sleep or diet, or disclosure. Keep existing care, advice, monitoring and support independent. Categories justify no medicine changes, supplements, cancelled support, delayed assessment or dismissal of persistent concerns as only seasonal. Answers and records stay in page memory without drafts, submission, questionnaire analytics or personal-result addresses. Completing clears answer state; exit, retake, reload and leaving clear the record without restoration. Copying includes only the public title and entry, not patterns, categories or counts. Clearing erases no screenshots, browser records or information already seen. You can ask a qualified professional without completion, a count or another season or year. Immediate danger or inability to stay safe calls for local emergency assistance rather than a decision through this page.
